name: Aurora Wireless Headphones
description: Over-ear, active noise cancellation, 40 hours on a charge. The memory-foam cups are the reason you can still wear them on hour six.

name: Pulse True Wireless Earbuds
description: Small earbuds with adaptive EQ and a wireless charging case. IPX5, so sweat is not a problem.

name: Boom Portable Speaker
description: 360-degree sound in a shell you can drop. Waterproof. Pair two of them for stereo.

name: Studio Condenser Microphone
description: Cardioid condenser, USB-C, zero-latency monitoring through the headphone jack. Built for streaming and podcasts.

name: Retrospin Vinyl Turntable
description: Belt-driven deck with a built-in preamp, plus Bluetooth out if you want to be modern about it.

name: Nova Smartwatch Series 5
description: AMOLED screen, GPS, heart rate and sleep tracking, seven days of battery. Pairs with any phone.

name: FitBand Active 3
description: Slim band, heart rate around the clock, 50 workout modes. Two weeks between charges.

name: Halo Smart Ring
description: Titanium ring that tracks sleep, readiness and temperature trends. No screen, which is the point.

name: TrailMaster Rugged GPS Watch with Solar Charging, Barometric Altimeter, Emergency Beacon and Military-Grade Shock Resistance
description: The longest product name in this store, kept that way on purpose for testing text truncation. It is also a very good watch for a week in the mountains.

name: MiniSteps Kids Tracker
description: An activity tracker for kids, with games that only unlock if they actually move. Parents control what gets shared.

name: Apex Pro Controller
description: Hall-effect sticks that will not drift, four remappable back paddles, adjustable trigger stops.

name: TypeStorm Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable 75% board, gasket mount, per-key RGB. Ships with lubed linears already in it.

name: Glide Ultralight Mouse
description: 58 grams, 26K sensor, 90 hours of battery. You stop noticing it is there after a day.

name: Quantum VR Headset
description: Standalone headset with pancake lenses, 4K per eye and full-colour passthrough. The most expensive thing we sell.

name: Retro Arcade Fight Stick
description: Full-size stick with genuine Sanwa parts and a tournament lock switch. Heavy enough to stay on your lap.

name: CastPad Stream Controller
description: 15 LCD keys for scenes, sounds and lights. The plugin library covers most of what you would otherwise script yourself.

name: Lumen Smart Bulb 4-Pack
description: Four colour bulbs, 16 million shades, schedules that follow the sun. No hub to plug in anywhere.

name: Sense Learning Thermostat
description: Learns your routine in about a week and stops heating an empty house. The e-ink display is unusually nice to look at.

name: GuardCam Outdoor Camera
description: 2K outdoor camera with colour night vision and person detection that runs on the device. No monthly fee.

name: PowerPlug Smart Duo
description: Two smart plugs with energy monitoring and schedules. Cheapest way to find out what your fridge costs you.

name: Sentry Door & Window Sensor Kit
description: Five slim sensors, instant phone alerts, and triggers you can hang automations off. Batteries last about two years.

name: Sticky Cable Clip
description: One reusable silicone clip that holds up to three cables. That is the entire product.

name: Nexus 9-in-1 USB-C Hub
description: Two HDMI outs, gigabit ethernet, 100W passthrough and three USB-A ports in an aluminium body.

name: Elevate Laptop Stand
description: Machined aluminium stand that puts your laptop at eye level and folds flat for a bag.
